title: Provide proper accommodation for resident workers
what: Where workers live on the premises where they are employed (outside the cities and towns the Act excludes), provide accommodation proper and sufficient for their comfort and health, built to the standards the Act sets.

sources.title: Workers' Accommodation Act 1952 (Qld)
sources.quote: Where workers during their employment reside on the premises on, in, about, or in connection with which they are employed, accommodation proper and sufficient for their comfort and health shall be provided in buildings on those premises

administration.who: Minister administering the Workers' Accommodation Act 1952 (Qld), and its inspectors

sources.title: Workers' Accommodation Act 1952 (Qld)

sources.quote: This Act shall be administered by the Minister and, subject to the Minister, by inspectors and other officers appointed or deemed to be appointed under and for the purposes of this Act.
